sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and scattered across junior members with small amounts; market fear (39/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (295.2) combined with recent CPI event and earnings in 19 days creates hostile macro backdrop for ABBV positioning.
